archetypes.name: timing-idempotency
archetypes.rationale: Step 5 timing rows depend on inverted awk exit semantics being fixed without changing ledger shape.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 5 resume timing path for idempotency. Check that existing ledger rows skip recording, missing rows still record when the start timestamp is numeric, and the predicate columns remain unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
